card.name: Spots before a non-American country name
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation (a space, comma, close bracket, of, in, the) in general web text about history or geography, just before a country or place name that is not American, such as Canada, Brazil, Germany or Australia.

modes.label: Punctuation after place or dates
modes.description: A comma or closing bracket after a foreign place or life dates, before more biography or a country name.
modes.example: Rio de Janeiro<<,>> Brazil, from is June 20

modes.label: Linking word before a country
modes.description: A short word like in, of, by or the that comes right before Canada or a German or Canadian institution.
modes.example: blatantly meddling<< in>> Canada’s political affairs seals the election for

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: A space after a date in a page-update line, before the year.
modes.example: This page last updated 27 July<< >>2006 Unless otherwise noted

card.writes: It pushes down the word American and its Chinese equivalents, so the next word is less likely to be about the USA.
card.plain: It fires where a non-US country is about to be named and discourages the model from saying American.
